1770-2226-4713.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts.
1770-2226-4713.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-4713.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Lumengrid Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Lumengrid Drake enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

997-2459-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
997-2459-5006-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Rograkh, causing you to scry 1
Repeat.

317-1475-2921.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional modified creature with power 1 or greater.
317-1475-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another modified creature with power one or greater.
When the creature dies, Mazirek and One with the Kami triggers.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Mazirek trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

147-413-1893.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-1893.description:
Cast Shallow Grave by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Shallow Grave.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Shallow Grave
Resolve the Shallow Grave copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

967-3809-3899-4772-7087.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

222-527-7297-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-7297-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6495-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X creature cards in all graveyards.
6495-6972-7231.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
6495-6972-7231.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

654-2557-3129-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1887-2021-2060-2445.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2421-3705-5231-7183.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3967-4053-4336-6989.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1017-3532-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

392-3532-3949-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

3053-3767-3918-4875.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-677-1115-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-955-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

5670-5870-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-5870-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1879-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1879-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
1879-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

2510-3967-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2510-3967-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2510-3967-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-4484-4871-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-4484-4871-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2043-4050-6441-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

698-2609-4474-5153.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 3 or more life this turn.
698-2609-4474-5153.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Activate Sunstrike Legionnaire by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping Sunstrike Legionnaire.
Repeat from step 2.

372-4681-5399.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Pirated Copy.
372-4681-5399.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Pirated Copy's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Pirated Copy ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Pirated Copy leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Pirated Copy into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Pirated Copy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

2583-3921-5870-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
2583-3921-5870-5902.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-586-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

864-5626-5733.manaNeeded: {5}{U} the first turn, with {7}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
864-5626-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
864-5626-5733.description:
Deal combat damage using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Eternal Witness, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

864-997-2639-3254-4871.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
864-997-2639-3254-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one non-Human creature.
864-997-2639-3254-4871.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable, putting it on top of a non-Human creature you control.
When Nethroi enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nethroi.
When Nethroi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Nethroi trigger from step 2, returning Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Nethroi from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime.
When Eternal Witness and Mitotic Slime die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Mitotic Slime triggers once.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Mitotic Slime trigger, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, they each trigger and Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice.
Resolve both Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Ooze triggers, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing two Oozes.
When the Oozes die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Activate the seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{G/W}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

181-1558.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
You control a number of nonlegendary artifact creatures that do not have summoning sickness equal to five divided by the number of opponents you have minus one, rounded up.
Opponents cannot block and kill creatures you control.
181-1558.description:
Declare a sufficient number of nonlegendary artifact creatures as attackers.
Each creature's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of each creature attacking each other opponent.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the creature tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At end of combat, exile any remaining tokens created by myriad abilities.
Repeat each turn.

1308-2043-2585-5295.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Grim Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Grim Monolith tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1924-2034-4013.description:
Cast White Sun's Twilight with X equal to 2 by paying {2}{W}{W}.
In response, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, copying White Sun's Twilight.
Resolve that copy, gaining 2 life and creating two 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two Phyrexian Mite creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite colorless mana, you may repeat while skipping step 5 to gain infinite Phyrexian Mite tokens.

1339-3394-3983.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to draw a card.
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
1339-3394-3983.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1171-1409-2936.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Garth.
1171-1409-2936.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing itself, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, exiling and returning onto the battlefield.
Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

3078-4222-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.
3078-4222-4644.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.

972-1061-1953.manaNeeded: {6}{U}{U}{U}{U} on your first turn, with {2}{U}{U} available on each extra turn
972-1061-1953.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
972-1061-1953.description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Timestream Navigator token.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it and putting it onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 2.
